name: sfbayferry-trmnl
description: Node tooling for the TRMNL plugin: compiles the type-safe transform-src/transform.ts into the plain JS trmnlp/TRMNL execute (src/transform.js), and renders docs/screenshots/*.png via headless Chromium. The plugin itself (src/*.liquid, settings.yml) is otherwise a trmnlp (Ruby) project — this is not part of the plugin runtime.
